newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU seen valuing early-Sep wheat around $144. [CORRECTED 23:20 GMT]
newsitem.headline: EU seen valuing early-Sep wheat around $144. [CORRECTED 23:20 GMT]

text.p: A European Union award of 105,000 tonnes of free-market soft wheat at a maximum refund of 0.87 Ecus per tonne values a tonne of early September French wheat at $144.44 per tonne, Reuters calculates.
The figure, which should be regarded as an estimate only, is based on benchmark standard-quality French milling wheat at Rouen and may vary significantly for other EU origins and types.
The calculation uses the following assumptions gathered from market sources and Reuters data.
(corrects to include the conversion from Ecus)
Implied fob price in dollars $144.44 dollars/tonne
The same formula suggests an unsubsidised French fob price of $147.60 per tonne. Sep U.S. soft red winter $127 per tonne.
